scope: Mission 4.2 and everything after; overrides every other autonomy, authority, risk-class, integration or execution rule
allowed_without_approval: purely local technical operations for Deputy itself: reading files, calculations, validation, tests, temporary computation, rebuilding generated models, non-mutating health checks
forbidden_without_approval: any other write/mutation in an external or authoritative system
not_approval: a previous approval for another action
general conversation such as 'looks good' unless it clearly refers to the exact proposed action
valid_approval_examples: another unmistakable affirmative instruction from Gev referring to the presented action
presentation_before_approval: statement: nothing has been changed yet
multi_step: Gev may approve a clearly enumerated batch; only those exact steps may run; any additional mutation discovered during execution needs a new approval

retries.rule: approval never authorizes blind duplicate execution
retries.if_outcome_unknown: stop and report RESULT_UNKNOWN; no duplicate write until reconciled

future_autonomy: only through a separate explicit owner decision and policy change
enforcement_note: The Skill System authority ladder already blocks EXECUTE_EXTERNAL/EXECUTE_MATERIAL without an approval token; the Mission 4.2 action runtime must bind that token to the exact presented action (this file is the canonical statement of the rule).
